mechanisms.quote: Responses are cached in Redis keyed by team context
This eliminates redundant DB queries from badge polling across all users.
Badge now polls /api/announcements/ids (returns only IDs) instead of /api/announcements (returns full content).
Eliminates per-user polling and mark-read POST requests, reducing server load during competitions.
